registry_purpose: Canonical declaration of current Technical Docs sources, ownership, provenance, publication state, and portfolio relationships.

ownership_contract.curated: Portfolio-owned content. Registry tooling must never overwrite it.
ownership_contract.generated: Source-derived content. Only explicitly declared generated targets may be replaced by a future sync runner.
ownership_contract.vendor: .vendor/technical-docs/<project_id>/ is transient working state and must remain untracked.

sources.documentation_scope: Local setup, data, notebooks, model topology, pipeline, architecture, results, and local serving.
sources.evidence_scope: Atlas evidence includes local execution and a sanitized cloud blueprint; no current production deployment is claimed.
sources.provenance: Source repository is linked from the local documentation; no source commit/tag lock is established by the supplied implementation source.
sources.update_policy: manual_curated; verify source alignment before material technical changes

sources.documentation_scope: Synchronized project README, technical documentation, reports, and release notes for the published snapshot.
sources.evidence_scope: Frozen portfolio evidence boundary remains tied to v0.4.0-alpha.1.
sources.provenance: Fetch and link rewriting are pinned by default to v0.4.0-alpha.1.
sources.update_policy: explicit_ref_change_only; Atlas evidence boundary must not move implicitly

sources.documentation_scope: Package overview plus synchronized link prediction, QAP, ERGM/STERGM approximation, methodology, examples, notebooks, and releases.
sources.evidence_scope: Atlas context describes 2026 Python network-statistical software with explicit approximation boundaries.
sources.provenance: Current fetch follows the moving main branch; generated output is not reproducible from a stable ref alone until an immutable resolved commit is recorded.
sources.update_policy: resolve and record immutable commit for every future normalized update; retain explicit release/evidence boundaries

sources.documentation_scope: Getting started, API overview, architecture, examples, contributing guidance, and releases for the pure-Lua statistics library.
sources.evidence_scope: Strategic Builder Journey bridge in Atlas governance; not absorbed into the Liasoft collection.
sources.provenance: Source repository is linked; no machine-readable source ref is established by the supplied implementation source.
sources.update_policy: manual_curated; release alignment should be verified before updates

sources.documentation_scope: Getting started, examples, mesh behavior, API reference, architecture, and releases for the Gideros Lua utility.
sources.evidence_scope: Creative Roots evidence inside the main portfolio; not a current product showcase.
sources.provenance: Local documentation links to the source repository; some visual assets are referenced from the moving master branch.
sources.update_policy: manual_curated; pin remote asset URLs to immutable commit/tag when practical

candidates.onboarding_policy: Blocked until source inspection, source-mode decision, ref policy, and Atlas relationship decision are separately approved.
